menu.description: Create rules that hide, or allow only, payment and shipping methods at checkout.
menu.label: Method Restrictions

schema.label: Apply payment and shipping method restrictions
schema.name: restrictionsEnabled

schema.default: checkmo, banktransfer, cashondelivery, purchaseorder, free, braintree, paypal_express
schema.label: Payment method codes your store offers, comma-separated (used by 'allow only' rules and the Admin)
schema.name: paymentMethods

schema.default: flatrate_flatrate, freeshipping_freeshipping, tablerate_bestway, ups_GND, usps_1, fedex_FEDEX_GROUND, dhl_P
schema.label: Shipping methods your store offers as carrier_method, comma-separated (used by 'allow only' rules and the Admin)
schema.name: shippingMethods

schema.label: Time zone for day and time conditions (IANA name, for example Europe/London)
schema.name: timezone

customInstallationSteps.description: Provision App Builder Database Storage and create the collection for restriction rules.
customInstallationSteps.name: Set up database

messages.postInstallation: Method Restrictions is installed. Add the Commerce webhook signing key to the app (see docs/installation.md), then open Method Restrictions in the Commerce Admin to add your first rule. New rules are off until you switch them on.
messages.preInstallation: Method Restrictions stores rules in App Builder Database Storage and checks Commerce webhook signatures. Make sure App Builder Data Services is added to your workspace and webhook signing is switched on in Commerce.

metadata.description: Hide, or allow only, payment and shipping methods at checkout by customer group, cart totals, weight, address, products, categories, store view, day and time, and coupon code.
